question: Does the previously observed net-versus-inventory tradeoff persist on new paired synthetic paths?
freeze_scope: Existing policies and simulator fixed before evaluating the listed confirmation seeds; no external preregistration or timestamp authority is claimed.
exposure_definition: Arithmetic mean of absolute end-of-batch inventory across all 240 batches before liquidation, including zero inventory.
contrasts: Inventory skew minus symmetric and delayed refresh minus symmetric, separately in each regime.
interval: Pointwise two-sided 95% Student t, sample sd with ddof=1, df=31; pair before estimating uncertainty; no multiplicity adjustment.
interpretation_rule: For each contrast and regime, upper net interval below zero and upper exposure interval below zero confirms lower net with lower exposure. Otherwise retain the unresolved or opposite finding. No aggregate winner or policy retuning.
sample_rule: Exactly 32 seeds per regime; no optional stopping or dropping seeds.

costs.liquidation: Five refreshed finite levels per side at terminal mid +/-3..7, ten units each; liquidation fees included in net.

data: Synthetic pre-generated draws shared by policies within seed and regime; regimes reuse seeds and are not independent replicates.
